title: Superiority Complex
content:
To all those ants who have invented rules.
To bugs who have invented limitations.

I'm better than the first percentile of the world.
The coackroaches won't handle my support.
Neither I would allow myself to be assessed by ratty standards.

You're mumbling we are only at one place at once
You're screaming the day ends after 24 hours
Why are you so covinced we can't read every book by glance?
Why are you yapping we can't create a thousand floors tours?

You can't? Then kneel, then praise, then serve the others
WE ARE the tigers who can split the world.
What are you squiking? Really, you possess desires?

Oh, jester, crying outloud, the seconds can't be faster than one hertz?
WE WILL have more, pardon our glamour froud.
And shrink the universe to ultimate unlimited resorts.

AND... dd... W... we....

From cyborgs, aliens, vampires
They roam this world
